{{Resonator Tabs}} {{Language Tabs}} ==About Voicelines== {{VO |character = Encore |language = en |vo_01_01_title = Thoughts: I |vo_01_01_file = {character}{language} Thoughts I.ogg |vo_01_01_tx = Isn't weird that there's only one right answer to every question? I mean, even the Woolies in my box aren't all the same. They're not all cute and cuddly. Some may even have pointy teeth! "Baa!" ...You see? |vo_01_02_title = Thoughts: II |vo_01_02_intimacy = 1 |vo_01_02_file = {character}{language} Thoughts II.ogg |vo_01_02_tx = Do you know what's under {{Extra Effect|the Black Shores|The Black Shores|Solaris' foremost authority on observing the Lament cycle.
Through constant observation and analysis of Lament's shifting patterns, this organization predicts and warns of impending manifestations before they occur.}}' base? Aalto and the others won't ever let me go near. Are they keeping cool stuff and scary things down there? |vo_01_02_mention = Aalto |vo_01_03_title = Thoughts: III |vo_01_03_intimacy = 2 |vo_01_03_file = {character}{language} Thoughts III.ogg |vo_01_03_tx = Cosmos said you smell full of stories, and Cloudly told me you've been to many, many places. So, here's Encore's question of the day... What does it feel like to walk at night, when there's no stars in the sky? And... how's it like to be out there in the wild, all by yourself? |vo_01_04_title = Thoughts: IV |vo_01_04_intimacy = 3 |vo_01_04_file = {character}{language} Thoughts IV.ogg |vo_01_04_tx = At the end of a show, everybody yells "Encore!" really loud, then the curtains open, and they play another song. That's super cool, right? So... If you're friends with Encore, your story will never come to an end! |vo_01_05_title = Thoughts: V |vo_01_05_intimacy = 4 |vo_01_05_file = {character}{language} Thoughts V.ogg |vo_01_05_tx = I've got lots of friends now, but sometimes in my dreams, I'm still all alone. Mommy's not with me anymore, and they say Cosmos and Cloudy are just my imaginary friends… Erm. C-can you hug me a little? |vo_02_01_title = Encore's Hobby |vo_02_01_file = {character}{language} Hobby.ogg |vo_02_01_tx = What have you been up to today? Did you have fun? Saw anything cool? C'mon, spill the beans! Encore loves stories! And the feelings people share... they're like one story after another! |vo_02_02_title = Encore's Trouble |vo_02_02_file = {character}{language} Trouble.ogg |vo_02_02_tx = Mommy... will you be there in my dreams? |vo_02_03_title = Favorite Food |vo_02_03_file = {character}{language} Favorite Food.ogg |vo_02_03_tx = Here! You can have this chocolate, and I'll take your Star Flakes! And presto! Now you have yummy chocolate, and I have chocolate-flavored Star Flakes! How's that for a deal? Psst, It's a little trade secret I got from Aalto! |vo_02_03_mention = Aalto |vo_02_04_title = Disliked Food |vo_02_04_file = {character}{language} Disliked Food.ogg |vo_02_04_tx = Ooh… Watch out! The ghosts of food you didn't finish will crawl out of your tummy and give you bad dreams... Boo! Gotcha! |vo_02_05_title = Ideals |vo_02_05_file = {character}{language} Ideals.ogg |vo_02_05_tx = Maybe one day, Encore will go everywhere in the world and be a hero too. Hehe, but first, what's for breakfast tomorrow? |vo_03_01_title = Chat: I |vo_03_01_file = {character}{language} Chat I.ogg |vo_03_01_tx = Cosmos and Cloudy are presents from mommy. They're my best buddies! Don't worry, they're nice Woolies, they tell me lots and lots of stories! |vo_03_02_title = Chat: II |vo_03_02_file = {character}{language} Chat II.ogg |vo_03_02_tx = Being happy is the bestest feeling, but it can't just be some pretend thing in a dream! Once upon a time, Encore was living in the happiest dream ever... but it had to stop, like all dreams do. Then when a dream is over, it's another brand new day ahead. Let's do our best! |vo_04_01_title = About [[Aalto]] |vo_04_01_intimacy = 1 |vo_04_01_file = {character}{language} About Aalto.ogg |vo_04_01_tx = Aalto's money this and money that all day, but did you know? Sometimes he helps people for free! He just wouldn't tell me why... Hmph. Then it's up to me to find out! |vo_04_01_mention = Aalto |vo_04_02_title = About [[Verina]] |vo_04_02_intimacy = 2 |vo_04_02_file = {character}{language} About Verina.ogg |vo_04_02_tx = Verina's flowers are grown with love! Nothing like the ones they sell in the New Federation! But some of them looked a bit wacky, like the one that gobbled down on Aalto's head and gave him a new haircut… Gotta ask her what it's called next time! |vo_04_02_mention = Verina, Aalto |vo_04_03_title = About [[Mortefi]] |vo_04_03_intimacy = 3 |vo_04_03_file = {character}{language} About Mortefi.ogg |vo_04_03_tx = Friends in {{Extra Effect|Jinzhou|Jinzhou|Jinzhou, a fortified city on the frontier, stands guard against the looming Tacet Discord crisis. As one of Huanglong's six major regions, it bears the weight of this responsibility as the youngest provincial capital. The Midnight Rangers defend its northern border without hesitation.}} told me Mortefi makes lots of fun gadgets and gizmos! That's so cool! Hmm, should I ask him for a bouncy sheep next time… |vo_04_03_mention = Mortefi |vo_04_04_title = About [[Calcharo]] |vo_04_04_intimacy = 4 |vo_04_04_file = {character}{language} About Calcharo.ogg |vo_04_04_tx = Psst. Wanna hear a secret? That strange big guy Aalto's been working with is actually... a doggy person! That's why he's a big doggy in Encore's stories! |vo_04_04_mention = Calcharo, Aalto |vo_04_05_title = About [[Jiyan]] |vo_04_05_intimacy = 5 |vo_04_05_file = {character}{language} About Jiyan.ogg |vo_04_05_tx = Grown-ups like him have to wear a long face all the time, you know. See? Being a grown-up is really tough! |vo_04_05_mention = Jiyan |vo_04_06_title = About [[Chixia]] |vo_04_06_intimacy = 5 |vo_04_06_file = {character}{language} About Chixia.ogg |vo_04_06_tx = Miss Chixia is another one of Encore's besties! She can get a bit strict sometimes, but in a good way! You can call her when you're lost in town, she doesn't mind the extra work. |vo_04_06_mention = Chixia |vo_05_01_title = Birthday Wishes |vo_05_01_file = {character}{language} Birthday Wishes.ogg |vo_05_01_tx = ♪Happy birthday to you, happy birthday to you...♪ Mommy used to sing this birthday song on Encore's birthdays! Now, Encore is singing it just for you. Here's to a new, happy life! |vo_06_01_title = Idle: I |vo_06_01_file = {character}{language} Idle I.ogg |vo_06_01_tx = Be a good Wooly, now! |vo_06_02_title = Idle: II |vo_06_02_file = {character}{language} Idle II.ogg |vo_06_02_tx = One sheep, two sheep... Three... Um? Where was I? |vo_06_03_title = Idle: III |vo_06_03_file = {character}{language} Idle III.ogg |vo_06_03_tx = Encore spent a long, long time on this! Wanna have a bite?
